name: voice-profile
description: Measure your writing voice from your own pre-AI writing and calls, score your Big Five with quoted evidence, and get a prompt plus a pass/fail verifier that holds AI to your voice.

interface.longDescription: Voice Profile makes AI write the way you do. It measures your own pre-AI writing on ten features, finds your writing modes, and builds a prompt that holds any AI to your voice. A checker then scores each draft against your profile, pass or fail per feature, so you know when a draft drifts. It also scores your Big Five traits with quotes from your own words, and compares your style with 37 public-domain authors. In ChatGPT, a stateless measurement service runs the numbers and stores nothing.
